purpose: Test K (Battaglia B12 pressure / B16 gas-density laws refitted to FLAMINGO L1_m9 HYDRO_FIDUCIAL SOAP-HBT aperture integrals at all 71 outputs, forward-modelled at every halo's own radii): reads (K0, K1) and fits (K2, K3) on STRW maas; comparisons, parity checks, figures and the report are made locally from the fetched results
command: cd $STUDY_ROOT && nice -n 19 python -B K_soap_battaglia/run_test_k.py --full --workers 8 --scratch /tmp/nagainis_halfdome_testK [--stages k0,k1,k2,k3]   (through cluster_tests.py run K --workers 8 --rss-stop 24 --driver-args="--scratch /tmp/nagainis_halfdome_testK", which adds nice 19, ionice 7 and the load/memory guards)
smoke_command: maas: cluster_tests.py run K --workers 2 --driver-args="--smoke --scratch /tmp/nagainis_halfdome_testK_smoke --results K_soap_battaglia/results_smoke" (outputs 0077 and 0037, first 3,000,000 rows); local without data: python -B run_test_k.py --smoke --synthetic --workers 2 --results results_smoke_syn
scratch: /tmp/nagainis_halfdome_testK (maas node-local /tmp): per-halo arrays halo_<snap>.npz (float32) of the selected centrals, for re-reduction without re-reading; ours; deleted after the final fetch (recorded in maas_runs)
stages: k0 inventory, k1 reads + per-cell reduction (one worker per output), k2 per-cell fits, k3 global fits + bootstrap (default all, in order)
run3_commands: cluster_tests.py run K --workers 3 --driver-args="--stages k1 --snaps 77,37,8 --results K_soap_battaglia/results_k1check --keep-halo 0"  (K1 provenance check with the final code; compared with results/cells by k1_check_compare.py)
exit_status: 0 = completed; 1 = a stage raised (traceback in results/run_manifest.json); 3 = an output failed in k1

reads_on_maas_read_only.SOAP-HBT: /net/hypernova/data2/FLAMINGO/L1000N1800/HYDRO_FIDUCIAL/SOAP-HBT/halo_properties_00{07..77}.hdf5 (columns of k_common.COLUMNS over the row span of the selected centrals)

budget: reduced results < 300 MB (expected ~100 MB); remote home quota 3.9 GB shared with Test J: per-halo arrays only in /tmp
